entries.text: Hanging from a central pillar in the room is a prize trophy moose head, which looks and sounds to be singing quietly to itself
entries.raw_text: 1,Hanging from a central pillar in the room is a prize trophy moose head, which looks and sounds to be singing quietly to itself

entries.text: Along the far wall is a rickety self-playing piano that starts playing a tune known to one of the characters
entries.raw_text: 1,Along the far wall is a rickety self-playing piano that starts playing a tune known to one of the characters

entries.text: In the middle of the bar is a narrow, deep pit that other patrons occasionlly throw food and pour drink down
entries.raw_text: 1,In the middle of the bar is a narrow, deep pit that other patrons occasionlly throw food and pour drink down

entries.text: Penned into one corner of the main hall is a fighting pit constructed for pitting zombies against one another
entries.raw_text: 1,Penned into one corner of the main hall is a fighting pit constructed for pitting zombies against one another

entries.text: Along one portion of the floor is a cavity in the paneling and in the middle of it a hot spring of crimson water bubbles
entries.raw_text: 1,Along one portion of the floor is a cavity in the paneling and in the middle of it a hot spring of crimson water bubbles

entries.text: The center of the room is dominted by a long feast table loaded with rotten and spoiled food
entries.raw_text: 1,The center of the room is dominted by a long feast table loaded with rotten and spoiled food

entries.text: On one wall rests a large and exquisite portrait of the bar. The artistry of the painting moves, and those who stop to examine it see that it shows things 5 seconds into the future
entries.raw_text: 1,On one wall rests a large and exquisite portrait of the bar. The artistry of the painting moves, and those who stop to examine it see that it shows things 5 seconds into the future

entries.text: Behind the bar are three large torches with eerie blue fire that are humming a sleepy lullaby
